CASB DLP Rule Resource Delete Rule
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/casbDlpRules/:ruleId

Deletes the SaaS Security Data at Rest Scanning DLP rule based on the specified ID

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ruleId
int32
REQUIRED

Rule ID

QUERY PARAMETERS
ruleType
string

Possible values: [ANY, NONE, OFLCASB_DLP_FILE, OFLCASB_DLP_EMAIL, OFLCASB_DLP_CRM, OFLCASB_DLP_ITSM, OFLCASB_DLP_COLLAB, OFLCASB_DLP_REPO, OFLCASB_DLP_STORAGE, OFLCASB_DLP_GENAI]

Rule type

Responses
​
default

Successful Operation
